en.answer: In that case, since you would take 0 damage as a result of the effect of <<9778>>, the effect of <<11460>> cannot be activated.
en.question: When you would take effect damage, if you would take 0 damage as a result of the effect of <<9778>> already being applied, can you activate the effect of <<11460>> to Special Summon it?
